title: 【第2回】XcodeとCodexでiOS用PDFビューアを育てる――毎日のiPad試用で見つけた画質と表示の問題
summary: tyamada22 traces how daily iPad use exposed rendering, highlight alignment, and reading-order defects during Codex-assisted PDF-viewer development. An iOS team can inspect the actual drawing and coordinate changes behind an agent fix, then separate page grouping into testable logic; the author lacks matched images to prove the proposed cause of the rendering improvement.
takeaway: Check rendering and overlay coordinates against the same origin, and test reading order separately from the arrangement of pages within each spread.
